description: Rinkta connects your professional services workspace to ChatGPT. Search across tasks, clients, projects, and billable entries; read workspace, member, task, project, client, and entry details; and create new tasks and clients without leaving the conversation. Financial data (clients, projects, and billable entries) is only returned to workspace members whose role grants financial access.
